bookkeeping.rowText: On the lever's River (the no-wave Claim the finale lever opens, `?contract=the-claim&nowaves=`), the first gold the player's own pan lands (sim 4.87 s desktop, 4.77 s phone from the run-6 driver's own walk) writes ONE completed `e10-river` score (secured, wave 0, 5 gold, time at the pan) through `recordRunScore` and keeps the reel in the tape ring; a second pan, a reload or a re-pull writes nothing more; nothing writes on boot or on the lever alone (no seam within 6.4 m of the spawn). The run-6 bank assertion is red on base, green on the branch, both projects; the Book reads 'Secured: wave 0, 5 gold'. The COUNTY POST IS HELD (`RIVER_STANDING_POSTS_ENABLED = false`, `Game.ts:11151`): the assay cannot replay a River reel yet (F-RES1-1: the replay opens the raw River with no seams and reads a RunManager secure the ceremony never sets; F-RES1-6: browser seams follow the `?seed=` pin), so a posted standing would rank while pending and then be rejected; the follow-up slice `river-assay-1` flips the one line. F-RES1-4 fixed alongside (replay guard, agent rider, recorder label by `scoredContractId`). Spec `e2e/river-ending-score.spec.ts` 6/6 both projects (zero county POSTs asserted; the kept reel door-shaped: `validateRunTape` whole, the door's `onRequest` 200); task-025, m2-01, charter-press-totality 28/28; tsc, build rc 0; four existing tapes replay byte-identical on base and tip. Engine hash PINNED {PIN} (`Game.ts` only). Desk: F-RES1-3 (the raw River route spawns enemies with no seams), F-RES1-5 (the ending is silent in the run). Ledger: F-RES1-2 (the run-6 driver seeds a fake River row), F-RES1-7 (a playbook replay that stops early leaves an empty stream and the reel is refused, every contract, pre-existing). Deployed. `reviews/river-ending-score-1.md`.
